definitions.explanation: describes something that spreads, permeates, or affects gradually and gently
describes a warm sensation or emotional warmth that spreads through the body or heart

examples.japanese: {汗|あせ}がじんわり{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: Sweat started to slowly seep out.

examples.japanese: {痛|いた}みがじんわり{広|ひろ}がった。
お{風呂|ふろ}でじんわり{温|あたた}まった。
examples.english: I warmed up slowly in the bath.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{言葉|ことば}がじんわり{心|こころ}に{染|し}みた。
examples.english: His words gradually touched my heart.

examples.japanese: じんわりと{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}てきた。
{感動|かんどう}がじんわり{込|こ}み{上|あ}げてくる。
examples.english: Emotion slowly wells up inside me.

notes:
ONOMATOPOEIA:
A mimetic word ({擬態語|ぎたいご}) expressing gradual, gentle spreading

VARIATION:
- じんわり - standard form
- じわじわ - similar meaning, more emphasis on slowness
- じわっと - momentary version

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- じんわり{汗|あせ}をかく - to sweat gradually
- じんわり{温|あたた}まる - to warm up slowly
- じんわり{心|こころ}に{染|し}みる - to touch the heart
- じんわり{効|き}いてくる - to gradually take effect

RELATED:
- じわじわ - gradually (more persistent)
- ほんのり - faintly, gently
- ほかほか - warm and cozy
